package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"
)

const (
	PlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeQueue   = "ms-teacher-planner-onboarding-path-outcome"
	PlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeDurable = "ms-teacher-planner-onboarding-path-outcome-v1"
	plannerOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject = domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject
	maximumPlannerPathOutcomeBytes      = 64 * 1024
)

type plannerOnboardingPathOutcomeEnvelope struct {
	EventID       string          `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string          `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string          `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID   string          `json:"causation_id"`
	StudentID     string          `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    string          `json:"occurred_at"`
	SchemaVersion int             `json:"schema_version"`
	Data          json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
}

type plannerOnboardingPathOutcomeData struct {
	Schema         string  `json:"schema"`
	ExecutionID    string  `json:"execution_id"`
	HandoffID      string  `json:"handoff_id"`
	StudentID      string  `json:"student_id"`
	DialogID       string  `json:"dialog_id"`
	TeacherJobID   string  `json:"teacher_job_id"`
	Status         string  `json:"status"`
	CourseID       *string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID *string `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	FirstLessonID  *string `json:"first_lesson_id,omitempty"`
}

// DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome validates the frozen S9 v1 wire and
// rejects unknown envelope/data fields and status-inappropriate identifiers.
func DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome(payload []byte) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome, error) {
	if len(payload) == 0 || len(payload) > maximumPlannerPathOutcomeBytes {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, errors.New("planner onboarding path outcome payload is out of bounds")
	}
	var envelope plannerOnboardingPathOutcomeEnvelope
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("decode planner onboarding path outcome: %w", err)
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeVersion ||
		envelope.EventType != domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject || len(envelope.Data) == 0 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid planner onboarding path outcome envelope")
	}
	var data plannerOnboardingPathOutcomeData
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("decode planner onboarding path outcome data: %w", err)
	}
	if data.Schema != domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSchema ||
		data.StudentID != envelope.StudentID || data.ExecutionID != envelope.CorrelationID || data.HandoffID != envelope.CausationID {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, errors.New("inconsistent planner onboarding path outcome identities")
	}
	if err := rejectStatusInappropriatePlannerPathIDs(envelope.Data, data.Status); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, err
	}
	courseID, pathID, lessonID := optionalPlannerPathIDs(data)
	occurredAt, err := parsePlannerPathOutcomeOccurredAt(envelope.OccurredAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, err
	}
	return domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{
		EventID: envelope.EventID, EventType: envelope.EventType, CorrelationID: envelope.CorrelationID,
		CausationID: envelope.CausationID, StudentID: envelope.StudentID, OccurredAt: occurredAt,
		ExecutionID: data.ExecutionID, HandoffID: data.HandoffID, DialogID: data.DialogID,
		TeacherJobID: data.TeacherJobID, Status: data.Status, CourseID: courseID,
		LearningPathID: pathID, FirstLessonID: lessonID,
	})
}

// The frozen v1 contract requires PATH_READY-only identifiers to be absent
// for terminal non-ready outcomes. A pointer field alone cannot distinguish
// an omitted key from an explicit JSON null, so inspect the already strict
// decoded object for key presence before domain normalization.
func rejectStatusInappropriatePlannerPathIDs(raw json.RawMessage, status string) error {
	if status == domain.TeacherOnboardingPathReady {
		return nil
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields); err != nil {
		return errors.New("invalid planner onboarding path outcome data")
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"course_id", "learning_path_id", "first_lesson_id"} {
		if _, present := fields[key]; present {
			return errors.New("non-ready planner onboarding path outcome must omit path identifiers")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func optionalPlannerPathIDs(data plannerOnboardingPathOutcomeData) (string, string, string) {
	var courseID, pathID, lessonID string
	if data.CourseID != nil {
		courseID = *data.CourseID
	}
	if data.LearningPathID != nil {
		pathID = *data.LearningPathID
	}
	if data.FirstLessonID != nil {
		lessonID = *data.FirstLessonID
	}
	return courseID, pathID, lessonID
}

func parsePlannerPathOutcomeOccurredAt(value string) (time.Time, error) {
	parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)
	if err != nil || parsed.Location() != time.UTC || parsed.Format(time.RFC3339Nano) != value {
		return time.Time{}, errors.New("invalid planner onboarding path outcome occurred_at")
	}
	return parsed, nil
}

type PlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeSubscriber struct {
	Conn       *natsgo.Conn
	Handler    func(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome) (bool, error)
	Logger     *zap.Logger
	AckWait    time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

func (subscriber PlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if subscriber.Conn == nil || subscriber.Handler == nil {
		return errors.New("planner onboarding path outcome subscriber dependencies are required")
	}
	logger := subscriber.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = zap.NewNop()
	}
	ackWait := subscriber.AckWait
	if ackWait <= 0 {
		ackWait = 30 * time.Second
	}
	retryDelay := subscriber.RetryDelay
	if retryDelay <= 0 {
		retryDelay = 5 * time.Second
	}
	stream, err := subscriber.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = stream.QueueSubscribe(plannerOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject, PlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeQueue, func(message *natsgo.Msg) {
		outcome, decodeErr := DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome(message.Data)
		if decodeErr != nil {
			logger.Warn("terminate invalid planner onboarding path outcome", zap.Error(decodeErr))
			_ = message.Term()
			return
		}
		processed, handleErr := subscriber.Handler(ctx, outcome)
		if handleErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(handleErr, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome) {
				logger.Warn("terminate rejected planner onboarding path outcome", zap.String("event_id", outcome.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
				_ = message.Term()
				return
			}
			logger.Warn("retry planner onboarding path outcome", zap.String("event_id", outcome.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
			_ = message.NakWithDelay(retryDelay)
			return
		}
		if err := message.AckSync(); err != nil {
			logger.Warn("ack planner onboarding path outcome", zap.String("event_id", outcome.EventID), zap.Error(err))
			return
		}
		logger.Debug("planner onboarding path outcome handled", zap.String("event_id", outcome.EventID), zap.Bool("processed", processed))
	}, natsgo.BindStream(LearningPlannerEventsStream), natsgo.Durable(PlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeDurable), natsgo.ManualAck(), natsgo.AckExplicit(), natsgo.DeliverAll(), natsgo.AckWait(ackWait))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
